title: Xanthe and the Thorn
author: I. M. Dunmore
blurb: Edmund Thornbury, a thief who steals memories, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. But when a dying stranger presses a map into unwilling hands, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must find the door out of a country that no longer exists, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
